fullContent:
Sowbhagya Shunti Pak 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Striroga – 296 – 299 
 Introduction 
 Sowbhagya Shunti Pak is an effective Ayurvedic medicine useful in postnatal care. Ginger is the main ingredient of this medicine. This herbal medicine is a beneficial tonic that has properties to improve complexion, power, strength and longevity as well as improves digestive strength. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Kasheru ( Schoenoplectus grossus ) 24 g 
 Shringataka ( Trapa natans ) – 24 g 
 Kamala (Lotus) – 24 g 
 Musta ( Cyperus rotundus ) – 24 g 
 Caraway and cumin seeds – 24 g each 
 Nutmeg – 24 g 
 Clove – 24 g 
 Shaileya ( Parmelia lichen ) – 24 g 
 Nagkeshar ( Mesua ferrea ) – 24 g 
 Patra ( Cinnamomum tamala ) – 24 g 
 Cinnamon – 24 g 
 Shati ( Hedychium spicatum ) – 24 g 
 Dhataki ( Woodfordia fruticosa ) – 24 g 
 Cardamom – 24 g 
 Asparagus – 24 g 
 Coriander seeds – 24 g 
 Gajapippali ( Scindapsus officinalis ) – 24 g 
 Long pepper – 24 g 
 Pepper – 24 g 
 Loha Bhasma – 48 g 
 Abhrak Bhasma – 48 g 
 Shunti (Ginger) – 384 g 
 Sugar – 1.44 kg 
 Ghee – 384 g 
 Milk – 1.536 liters 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Prepare fine powder of Shunti and other ingredients. Now heat ghee and slightly roast powdered shunti in it. On the other side prepare sugar syrup. Add roasted shunti and other powdered ingredients to this sugar syrup and leave it to get the required consistency. 
 Dosage 
 Consume 5-10 grams 1-2 times a day after having meals or as suggested by an Ayurvedic doctor with milk or water. 
 Dose for children below 5 years – 1-2 grams, 1-2 times a day, along with a teaspoon of honey or warm water / milk. 
 Dose for children between 5 – 12 years – 5 grams 1-2 times a day along with a teaspoon of honey or warm water / milk. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Sowbhagya Shunti Pak is useful in the treatment of complications arising during postnatal care of the mother. 
 It can improve digestive power. 
 It is also an effective remedy for sprue and diarrhea 
 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 Its overdose can lead to stomach irritation 
 It must be taken strictly under medical directions or only after consulting an Ayurvedic doctor. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
